name: Synology Chat
author: Hiutaky
description: Synology Chat in the Omarchy bar: unread badge, read and reply to channels and direct messages, links, images, emoji and desktop notifications.

barWidget.description: Unread badge for Synology Chat with a panel to read channels and direct messages and reply.

schema.label: Server
schema.description: Optional. DSM address with port, e.g. https://nas.local:5001. Leave empty to use the one entered during setup.

schema.label: DSM user
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the one entered during setup. The password always lives in the keyring.

schema.label: Verify TLS certificate
schema.description: Turn on if your NAS has a certificate from a trusted CA.
